description:
Returns the catalog of supported blockchain assets, ticker symbols, and network standards.

USAGE GUIDELINES:
- USE WHEN: Discovering supported coins, validating tickers, or displaying network options prior to calling quote or limit tools.
- DO NOT USE: Calculating rates, exchange amounts, or network fees (use 'get_swap_quote' or 'get_pair_limits_and_fees').

PARAMETER INTENT & AGENT WORKFLOW:
- Context Window Optimization: Supplying 'privacy' or 'stablecoins' filters the catalog to a specific functional class, reducing token consumption when prompting users; omitting or passing 'all' returns the full multi-chain roster.
- Output Consumption: Tickers returned in 'currencies[].ticker' are guaranteed canonical symbols accepted by 'get_swap_quote' and 'get_pair_limits_and_fees'.

BEHAVIOR & SPECIFICATIONS:
- In-memory response (<5ms latency) returning up to 15 non-paginated asset records with 100% availability.
- Strictly read-only without external network dependencies.

category.description: Optional functional taxonomy filter to constrain output assets by blockchain architecture. Permitted values: 'all', 'privacy', 'stablecoins'.

name: list_supported_currencies
